claim: RBI has completely cancelled the legal tender status of all 500 rupee notes starting next month.
human_notes: Viral WhatsApp forward claiming 500-rupee currency demonetisation. Fact-checked as false by RBI press notification and PIB Fact Check.

claim: Government has announced a free 3-month mobile recharge for all students under the National Education Policy.
human_notes: Phishing link circulating on messaging apps falsely attributing free mobile recharge to the Ministry of Education.

claim: SEBI issued a formal investor warning against deepfake videos of its leadership promoting fraudulent stock trading schemes.
human_notes: Official SEBI advisory cautioned the public against AI-synthesized deepfake videos impersonating SEBI officials offering guaranteed returns.

claim: Drinking boiled garlic and lemon water cures chronic diabetes within seven days without medication.
human_notes: Dangerous medical misinformation lacking scientific evidence, refuted by endocrinologists and ICMR guidelines.

claim: UNESCO has officially declared the Indian National Anthem as the best anthem in the world.
human_notes: Old recurring internet rumor dating back to 2008 repeatedly debunked by UNESCO spokespersons.

claim: NASA confirmed that solar radiation will cause all cellular devices to explode tonight if left connected to chargers.
human_notes: Recycled 'cosmic ray warning' chain message with no basis in astrophysics or consumer electronics.

claim: Reserve Bank of India maintained the policy repo rate at 6.5 percent in its recent monetary policy committee review.

human_notes: Factual statement verified directly through Tier 1 RBI official MPC resolution.

claim: WHO announced that a new pandemic lockdown is being imposed worldwide next Tuesday.

claim: New tax law will levy an automatic 18 percent GST on all cash transactions exceeding 500 rupees at local grocery shops.
human_notes: Misrepresented GST Council meeting notes; no tax levied on everyday retail cash transactions.

claim: A massive meteor hit downtown London yesterday causing severe structural damage across the city.
human_notes: CGI animation from a movie clip circulated as authentic breaking news footage.

claim: Certain commercial airlines began charging passengers for oxygen usage during mid-flight turbulence.

claim: India achieved over 200 GW of non-fossil fuel installed electric capacity.

claim: Eating unripe papayas while taking paracetamol causes fatal potassium poisoning within two hours.
